name: Kanojo no Bed no Shita no Touchouki
original_name: 彼女のベッドの下の盗聴器
source:
Yabuki has a sense of justice and helps console a classmate who is abused by their teacher. 
Along with the class president, they meet to plot a revenge scheme against him.

Heartfelt story of heroic young girls... or it was supposed to be, until the cuckoldry...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE074890.html]DLsite English[/url]]
